name: Text to Speech (your voice)
summary: Reads a script in a voice you give it: five seconds of clean speech are enough for Chatterbox to copy the timbre, in 23 languages.

source.notes: The reference clip is loaded with core LoadAudio and handed to the node's audio_prompt in memory; the node never writes a temp wav. Same multilingual model as Text to Speech, same automatic download into ComfyUI/models/tts/chatterbox/.

inputs.label: Reference voice
inputs.help: 5 to 6 seconds of clean speech, one speaker, no music. The words do not matter, the timbre does.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.default: Bonjour, c'est moi. Ceci est une phrase lue avec ma propre voix.
inputs.help: Write it in the reference's language, or pick another one below.

inputs.label: Expressiveness
inputs.help: How far the reading leans into the emotion of the line.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: 0 lets the model pick a random seed.

notes: The timbre comes from the clip you upload, not from a trained model of the person: nothing is stored and nothing is trained, so it copies the voice of that recording only. A dry, close-miked voice follows best; music, noise or two speakers confuse it. Same weights as Text to Speech, downloaded once into ComfyUI/models/tts/chatterbox/. Use a voice you have the right to use.
